audience.text: Developers building Node.js applications that require PDF document processing, including those needing PDF parsing, editing, conversion, redaction, and form handling.

capabilities.text: Parses PDF documents including cross-reference tables and streams, supports multiple stream decoders, and recovers damaged files with detailed reporting.
capabilities.title: PDF Parsing and Recovery

capabilities.text: Edits pages, text, images, and vector graphics; supports text search, replace, redaction, and restyle operations with layout preservation or reflow.
capabilities.title: Content Editing

capabilities.text: Creates, fills, styles, and manages AcroForm fields, annotations, and interactive elements including signatures, with appearance regeneration.
capabilities.title: Form and Annotation Handling

capabilities.text: Converts PDF to HTML, Markdown, DOCX, EPUB, and image formats; supports PDF/A, PDF/X, and PDF/UA conversion and validation with detailed reports.
capabilities.title: Conversion and Export

capabilities.text: Supports encryption, digital signatures with timestamps and validation data, redaction, sanitization, and compliance validation for PDF/A, PDF/X, and PDF/UA.
capabilities.title: Security and Compliance

capabilities.text: Reads and writes tagged-PDF structure, supports auto-tagging, PDF/UA validation, and optional-content layers with visibility management.
capabilities.title: Document Structure and Accessibility

capabilities.text: Integrates with AI models for summarization, question-answering, and alt-text generation, with configurable budgets and cancellation support.
capabilities.title: AI Integration

capabilities.text: Supports async operations with cancellation signals and progress reporting for exports, conversions, validations, and optimizations.
capabilities.title: Async Operations and Progress

limitations.text: Resource limits are enforced during document operations; exceeding them raises ResourceLimitError with specific limit details.
Incremental save is not compatible with compressed, encrypted, linearized, or stream-filtered output, and refuses signed or recovery-opened documents.
Some features like complex text shaping require embedded fonts with explicit shape support; Standard-14 fonts do not shape.
PDF/A-1 transparency flattening is lossy and not reversible; it is not applied to signed or tagged pages by default.
SVG embedding has limitations: non-embedded fonts are substituted silently, external hrefs require a resolver, and some CSS features are unsupported.
XFA form conversion is one-way and discards the XFA packet; hybrid documents reconcile by name and may have geometry-less fields.

problems_solved.text: Enables parsing and manipulation of PDF documents with support for cross-reference tables, object streams, and various stream decoders, including recovery from damaged files.
Provides tools for redacting content, sanitizing hidden data, and securing documents with encryption and digital signatures.
Supports conversion between PDF and other formats (HTML, Markdown, DOCX, EPUB, images) and between PDF standards (PDF/A, PDF/X, PDF/UA).
Facilitates creation and editing of interactive PDF elements such as forms, annotations, bookmarks, and optional-content layers.

product_summary.text: Aspose.PDF-FOSS-for-TypeScript is a free, open-source, zero-dependency TypeScript library for reading, manipulating, and writing PDF files in Node.js.

uncertainties: The exact behavior of some advanced features like complex-text shaping with specific font configurations is not fully detailed.
The scope of support for certain PDF/X and PDF/A subtypes and conformance levels may require further verification.
The handling of some edge cases in SVG embedding, particularly with nested filters and external resources, may have undocumented limitations.
The interaction between incremental save and certain form or annotation features is not fully specified.
The behavior of some AI integration features with specific model providers or large documents may vary.
The exact impact of certain resource limits on complex operations like large table rendering or deep nesting is not quantified.
The support for some advanced font features like vertical writing or complex CMap chains may have undocumented constraints.
The handling of some PDF constructs like non-standard annotations or custom XMP schemas may not be fully covered.

workflows.name: Open and Edit PDF
workflows.text: Open a PDF file using Document.Open, access and modify pages, metadata, and content, then save the result with Document.Save.

workflows.name: Import and Render Content
workflows.text: Import content from HTML, Markdown, DOCX, or plain text using Document.AddHtml, Document.AddMarkdown, Document.AddDocx, or Document.AddPlainText, and render to images or other formats.

workflows.name: Redact and Sanitize
workflows.text: Mark or directly redact content by rectangle or text search, apply redactions, and sanitize hidden data including metadata, annotations, and optional content.

workflows.name: Sign and Secure
workflows.text: Sign documents with digital signatures supporting CMS/PAdES, add timestamps, embed validation data, and encrypt output with password or certificate-based encryption.

workflows.name: Validate and Convert Standards
workflows.text: Validate documents against PDF/A, PDF/X, and PDF/UA standards, and convert documents to these standards with detailed reporting of applied and unresolved issues.

workflows.name: Build and Style Content
workflows.text: Build multi-column flow documents, tables, and text blocks with styling, hyphenation, tab stops, and complex-text shaping for international scripts.
